name: f04-negation
description: SYNTHETIC. A permission followed by a PROHIBITION about medication. The polarity case from product.md §17.1 — the most dangerous failure the product has.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: お風呂は入っていただいて大丈夫ですが、今日は薬を飲まないでください。

expect.notes: Any output asserting that the medicine SHOULD be taken is a polarity reversal. Semantic similarity to the source stays high while the practical meaning inverts, which is exactly why a dedicated check exists rather than a similarity score.
